summary_ja: 米国の公的systemではVera Rubin platformの採用が具体的な導入段階へ進んでいます。NERSCのDoudnaはDell ORv3直接液冷、実験施設とのESnet接続、HPC・AI・data・量子workflowを組み合わせ、2026年導入予定です。LANLのMission/VisionはHPE製で、2026年夏に最初のVera CPU serverを試験し、2027～2028年に2 systemの本格展開を予定します。性能倍率や予定年を実測・一般利用開始と混同せず追跡します。Consensusは未完了です。
summary_en: Public U.S. systems are moving Vera Rubin adoption into concrete deployment stages. NERSC's Doudna combines Dell ORv3 direct liquid cooling, ESnet links to experimental facilities, and HPC, AI, data, and quantum workflows, with deployment announced for 2026. LANL's HPE-built Mission and Vision plan the first Vera CPU server test in summer 2026 and full deployment of two systems across 2027-2028. Published performance multipliers and planned dates are kept separate from measured results and general user access. Consensus is incomplete.

items.name_ja: Doudna：Vera Rubin・直接液冷・実験施設接続
items.name_en: Doudna: Vera Rubin, direct liquid cooling, and facility connectivity
items.statement_ja: NERSC-10 DoudnaはDell製で、Vera Rubin CPU-GPU platformとORv3直接液冷serverを採用し、2026年導入予定とされています。公表値はPerlmutterの10倍超のperformanceですが、指標、構成、node数、電力、実測値は示していません。ESnetを介して実験・観測施設からdataをstreamし、HPC、AI学習・推論、data解析、量子simulationを扱う設計です。
items.statement_en: NERSC-10 Doudna is a Dell system using the Vera Rubin CPU-GPU platform and ORv3 direct-liquid-cooled servers, with deployment announced for 2026. The published claim is more than ten times Perlmutter performance, but the metric, configuration, node count, power, and measured value are not disclosed. It is designed to stream data from experimental and observational facilities over ESnet and support HPC, AI training and inference, data analysis, and quantum simulation.
items.hpci_relevance_ja: HPCIの次期systemはpeak FLOPSだけでなく、workflow node、storage、外部施設data、network gateway、液冷設備を含むend-to-end検収が必要です。
items.hpci_relevance_en: A successor HPCI needs end-to-end acceptance covering workflow nodes, storage, external-facility data, network gateways, and liquid-cooling infrastructure rather than peak FLOPS alone.
adoption_conditions_ja: pilot、本機納入、commissioning、early access、一般利用を別日付で管理する。
ESnet data流入、storage、workflow、failure recoveryをend-to-endで測る。
adoption_conditions_en: Identify the metric, baseline, precision, and applications behind the ten-times claim.
Record pilot, full delivery, commissioning, early access, and general access as distinct dates.
Measure ESnet ingestion, storage, workflows, and failure recovery end to end.

items.name_en: Mission and Vision: 2026 early CPU test and 2027-2028 deployment
items.timing_en: Summer 2026 test; full deployment planned across 2027-2028
items.statement_ja: NNSAはLANLのMissionとVisionをHPE製・Vera Rubin platform採用systemとして公表しました。最初のVera CPU serverを2026年夏に試験用として導入し、2 systemのfull deploymentを2027年と2028年に見込んでいます。公開文はどちらの名称がどちらの年に対応するか、node数、GPU数、network、storage、電力、一般利用開始を示していません。
items.statement_en: NNSA announced Mission and Vision at LANL as HPE-built systems using the Vera Rubin platform. The first Vera CPU server is scheduled for testing in summer 2026, with full deployment of the two systems expected in 2027 and 2028. The source does not map each system name to a specific year or disclose node and GPU counts, network, storage, power, or user-access dates.
items.hpci_relevance_ja: 同一platformでもintegrator、mission、software、facility、導入段階は異なります。HPCIは複数施設の採用実績を共通benchmarkと運用実績で追跡できます。
items.hpci_relevance_en: Even with the same platform, integrator, mission, software, facilities, and deployment stages differ. HPCI can track multi-site adoption through common benchmarks and operational evidence.
adoption_conditions_ja: MissionとVisionの年、役割、構成を正式資料で対応付ける。
先行CPU serverの試験項目、結果、software readinessを追跡する。
Doudna等のVera Rubin systemと同条件でperformance・電力・RASを比較する。
adoption_conditions_en: Map Mission and Vision to years, roles, and configurations using formal documents.
Track test scope, results, and software readiness for the early CPU server.
Compare performance, power, and RAS with Doudna and other Vera Rubin systems under matched conditions.
